values.alarm_description: commit-worker DLQ received a poison request (transient-exhausted / corrupt / crash-orphan). Inspect org/mcp/commit_queue/dlq/ (or the configured queue root) for the offending request.

commit-worker average commit latency (enqueue->result) exceeded 5000ms over 10min. Degradation signal, not necessarily an outage -- compare against the TO-6R mutex-baseline load-test. THRESHOLD IS A PLACEHOLDER pending that baseline.

commit-worker queue depth sustained >20 for >=5min -- slow-drain or stuck (but not fully dead, else WorkerDown would also fire). Check worker throughput / for a stuck request retry-looping. THRESHOLD IS A PLACEHOLDER pending TO-6R load-test baseline.

commit-worker daemon has not emitted WorkerLiveness for >=3min -- callers are silently degrading to the in-line mutex (D6 fallback). Check the worker process on the repo host; restart via commit-worker.sh if dead.

source.buildspec:
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    commands:
      - 'curl -sS https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/1.9.8/terraform_1.9.8_linux_amd64.zip -o /tmp/tf.zip'
      - 'unzip -o /tmp/tf.zip -d /usr/local/bin/ && terraform version'
      - 'pip install -q boto3 || true'
  build:
    commands:
      - 'export TERRAFORM_BIN=/usr/local/bin/terraform'
      - 'export DRIFT_SOURCE_ZIP_MTIME=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket opal-313476888478-lambda-artifacts --key drift-producer/source.zip --query LastModified --output text | xargs -I {} date -d {} +%s 2>/dev/null || echo "")'
      - 'python3 .tools/drift_producer.py --mode terraform'

alarm_description.constant_value: commit-worker DLQ received a poison request (transient-exhausted / corrupt / crash-orphan). Inspect org/mcp/commit_queue/dlq/ (or the configured queue root) for the offending request.

commit-worker average commit latency (enqueue->result) exceeded 5000ms over 10min. Degradation signal, not necessarily an outage -- compare against the TO-6R mutex-baseline load-test. THRESHOLD IS A PLACEHOLDER pending that baseline.

commit-worker queue depth sustained >20 for >=5min -- slow-drain or stuck (but not fully dead, else WorkerDown would also fire). Check worker throughput / for a stuck request retry-looping. THRESHOLD IS A PLACEHOLDER pending TO-6R load-test baseline.

commit-worker daemon has not emitted WorkerLiveness for >=3min -- callers are silently degrading to the in-line mutex (D6 fallback). Check the worker process on the repo host; restart via commit-worker.sh if dead.
